title: Perception, Quality, and Accuracy of Sunscreen Content on TikTok: SkinMedia Cross-Sectional Content Analysis
note: Roland-McGowan et al. 2025 (JMIR Dermatology, abstract): of the 100 most-liked TikTok videos for 'sunscreen', 6% were inaccurate (35% accurate, 57% opinion-based). A falsity verdict over a rank-truncated content sample (CONTENT, curated denominator), the same design as included studies such as the most-viewed COVID-19 YouTube videos. The pipeline's reason ('primarily quality/promotional') misdescribes an accuracy code.
